beaches.name: Chiliadou
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established at one end of the beach, beyond the rocks. Greek press pieces from 2018 and 2020 and a naturist directory with reports from 2013 and August 2017 describe it among the busiest naturist beaches in Greece; no designation by a named authority is documented.

beaches.name: Nea Styra south (Onion beach)
beaches.summary: Mixed nude and clothed use is reported on the beach south of the Venus Beach Hotel. A naturist directory carries one visitor report from September 2023 relaying hotel staff describing it as clothing-optional; no other report is documented.
